<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:8">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>סוסיא באוּרְיֵיה …</he> a horse is placed at his (the ox’s) crib., i.e. Israel is displaced and other nations feed on his soil.—
M. Kat. 10ᵇ למבני א׳ to build a stable (during the festive week). [Targ. II Esth. VI, 10; 11 אוּרַיָּא, read אוּרְיָא stable.]—Pl. אוּרְיָין, אוּרְוָותָא, (אוּרְיָיתָא) אֻרְוָותָא.
